name: Succulent Coffee
notes: Succulent Coffee is a tiny outdoor coffee/tea kiosk on the patio of The Brick Hotel, 306 N Tremont St, Oceanside (address-confirmed on the hotel's own page, joe.coffee directory listing, and Yelp). Checked: the hotel's own page for it (thebrickhotel.com/food-and-drink/succulent-coffee) has no menu or prices, only a description; joe.coffee's listing is a directory/review-aggregator page, not an ordering platform, and has no menu; no DoorDash, Grubhub or Uber Eats listing exists for it; a news article (Patch) reported the shop explicitly does not offer food due to space constraints and mobile ordering is not yet available. A third-party 'succulent-cafe.cafes-usa.com' page returned a large, fully-priced 40+ item breakfast/burger/sandwich menu (French Toast, Eggs Benedict, burgers, salads) under the name 'Succulent Cafe' - this was checked against the address and rejected as the wrong business: no address on that page matches 306 N Tremont St, and the menu (biscuits, burgers, dinner entrees) is entirely inconsistent with every other source's description of this shop as a coffee-and-plants kiosk with no kitchen. Did not exhaustively page through the virtualized 237-photo Yelp gallery looking for a dated menu-board photo, so this is recorded at low confidence rather than a hard not-found; a future pass could check for photos tagged menu/board specifically.
